title_hook: Not everything you carry belongs to you.
concept: Michelangelo's David: carving away everything that isn't the masterpiece
quote: Not everything you carry belongs to you. And not everything you lose is a loss.
core_metaphor: You are not constructing a better self. You are removing what obscures the self that was already there.
emotional_arc: burden -> fracture -> exposure -> recognition -> deliberate release
recurring_element: a single fully clothed adult in a charcoal long-sleeved shirt and trousers in a nearly black sculpture gallery, emerging from charcoal-black granite
character: The same person in every shot: a fully clothed adult in a charcoal long-sleeved shirt and trousers, a man in his early thirties with warm light-brown skin, dark brown eyes, short dark curly hair and a neatly trimmed short beard
material: All stone is the same charcoal-black granite (#1A1A1A): matte, coarse mineral grain, sharp fractured edges, lit by one narrow overhead ivory beam with cool blue-grey shadows
primary_prompt: Restrained photorealistic 9:16 sequence in a monumental, nearly black sculpture gallery: one fully clothed adult in a charcoal long-sleeved shirt and trousers, natural proportions, relaxed arms, chin slightly lowered, encased in rough charcoal-black granite (#1A1A1A), lit by a narrow ivory beam. Physically plausible fractures release heavy granite under real gravity, revealing intact charcoal clothing beneath. Antique-gold (#C6A94F) glints only inside fresh fractures; brief crimson (#DC143C) stress light precedes each break, never like blood or lava. The figure never becomes a gold statue. Ends with a fully clothed living person who looks into the lens and takes one step forward. Photoreal, cinematic chiaroscuro, tactile mineral grain. No metallic skin, no glowing lava, no exploding debris, no superhero pose.

hook.text: You were told to become more. More disciplined. More impressive. More complete.
hook.visual: Absolute darkness, then a narrow shaft of ivory (#F5F2EB) light reveals one fully clothed adult in a charcoal long-sleeved shirt and trousers, natural proportions, relaxed arms, chin slightly lowered, encased in rough charcoal-black granite (#1A1A1A), standing motionless in a monumental black gallery. Slow dolly forward. Three restrained impacts chip the forehead and cheek; a fleeting crimson (#DC143C) stress line precedes the last break and one living human eye appears, catching a muted antique-gold (#C6A94F) reflection. Photoreal, cinematic chiaroscuro, tactile mineral grain. No metallic skin, no glowing lava, no exploding debris, no superhero pose.

build.text: So you kept adding. Until you could no longer recognize what was underneath. But a sculptor does not add the figure to the stone.
build.visual: Intimate camera drift across heavy granite strata, scratches and mineral lines on one fully clothed adult in a charcoal long-sleeved shirt and trousers, natural proportions, relaxed arms, chin slightly lowered, encased in rough charcoal-black granite (#1A1A1A); the stone feels oppressive and the person beneath is hard to see. Then front-facing: most of the face still stone, one living eye looking into the lens, a tiny fragment falling from the lips, a first breath disturbing suspended bone-white (#F5F2EB) dust. A shoulder fractures and a heavy slab drops to the floor, intact charcoal fabric beneath a fading gold seam. Photoreal, cinematic chiaroscuro, tactile mineral grain. No metallic skin, no glowing lava, no exploding debris, no superhero pose.

pivot.text: He removes what conceals it. The expectations. The performances. The identities you inherited without choosing.
pivot.visual: Continuous push-in on one fully clothed adult in a charcoal long-sleeved shirt and trousers, natural proportions, relaxed arms, chin slightly lowered, encased in rough charcoal-black granite (#1A1A1A), now cracking without any visible strike. A fracture travels across the chest and stone separates along its own weakness in a slow bloom of ivory dust. A section falls from the upper back, then the jaw: human lips emerge and the figure inhales. Granite slides off both shoulders, revealing intact charcoal fabric; muted gold (#C6A94F) lights the fracture edges, then fades. Silhouette now unmistakably human. Photoreal, cinematic chiaroscuro, tactile mineral grain. No metallic skin, no glowing lava, no exploding debris, no superhero pose.

resolution.text: Not everything you carry belongs to you. And not everything you lose is a loss.
resolution.visual: Close on the hand of one fully clothed adult in a charcoal long-sleeved shirt and trousers holding a rough charcoal-black (#1A1A1A) stone fragment. The fingers deliberately open and release it; the fragment strikes the black floor in silence. Cut to the ankles: the last granite collars crack and fall, dark shoes settle onto the stone floor below intact trouser cuffs, ivory dust drifting down. Camera begins a slow, restrained rise. First act of choice, not force. Photoreal, cinematic chiaroscuro, tactile mineral grain. No metallic skin, no glowing lava, no exploding debris, no superhero pose.

mobius_close.text: Some things have to fall away before you can finally become...
mobius_close.visual: Head-and-shoulders portrait of one fully clothed adult in a charcoal long-sleeved shirt and trousers: natural facial features, subtle asymmetry, residual ivory (#F5F2EB) stone dust on intact clothing, granite rubble beside their dark shoes in the gallery. They take one quiet breath, look directly into the lens without smiling, and take exactly one deliberate step toward camera. The narrow ivory light beam narrows toward darkness, matching the opening frame. Photoreal, cinematic chiaroscuro, tactile mineral grain. No metallic skin, no glowing lava, no exploding debris, no superhero pose.

caption:
Some growth looks like addition.

Some looks like removal.

Not everything you carry belongs to you.

And not everything you lose is a loss.
